assertion_analysis.failure_condition: test_quiet_cycles_list_nothing_and_spawn_no_git counts real calls: _install_list_counter wraps recovery_watch.list_live and _install_spawn_counter counts git argv seen by subprocess.run. Reinstating the fixed-beat sweep advances the counter at every boundary, so `marks['list'][1] == marks['list'][0]` and `marks['spawn'][1] == marks['spawn'][0]` redden. Neither side is a value the test handed to the code; the counters observe the code's own calls.

test_a_touched_pointer_sweeps_exactly_once asserts `marks[1] - marks[0] == 1`, where the marks are list_live call counts read at boundaries while os.utime moves a pointer's mtime. This is the assertion the declared negative control reddens (negative-control.log, EXIT=1, `assert (1 - 1) == 1`), so its failure condition is demonstrated: a stamp that ignores mtime leaves the touch invisible and the delta 0.

test_a_death_is_delivered_within_one_beat_with_no_file_change flips the fixture's monkeypatched liveness flag (set up at tests/...:120-127) and asserts the yielded transitions name every live run. If _quiet_beat_snapshots dropped its _fresh_liveness re-probe and served the cached snapshot, no transition would be yielded and the assertion would redden. The liveness source is the fixture's own flag, not a value the assertion passes to the code.

No assertion in the added file can fail on the omission named in the third finding: nothing drives a change confined to a run's exit/worker/attempt record, a review-store candidate or a worktree head while the pointer, stream and manifest hold still. The durability score rests on the three assertions above, which guard the gate's firing and the liveness path, not the completeness of the fingerprint.

findings.text: follow-on: _stat_stamp re-implements a capability the repository already owns. reckon/capabilities.py:1290 has the public file_stamp(path) -> list[int] | None, documented as a cheap [mtime_ns, size] stamp of one path or None when absent — the same two fields this function returns, with None as its absent marker. file_stamp is already used inside reckon/crew (reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:704 stamps budget_lift.lifts_path()); the addition duplicates it in a new shape rather than extending or wrapping it, the only difference being the absent sentinel. In the same subsystem, reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py:106 _file_identity is the identity owner the classification keys on. Reuse is scored at the rubric cap for a duplicated capability.

follow-on: _sweep_lift_rows now sits inside `if sweep:` while the document it reads is not in the fingerprint. The fold reads <crew-home>/budget-lifts.json via lift_watch.sweep -> budget_lift.read_document (reckon/crew/budget_lift.py:142 lifts_path, directly under the config home). _crew_home_change_token stamps only live/, runs/, each live pointer, each live run's newest stream and its manifest, so granting or ending a lift moves no stamped file and the fold waits for an unrelated pointer, stream, manifest or directory-mtime movement; the base revision folded the document on every poll. The delay is bounded by the next such movement (in an active fleet, the next stream append), so it is recorded rather than held. The same gating now covers runs.sweep_unfollowed_sessions and _stop_delivered_reviews at recovery_watch.py:2555-2558.

follow-on: the quiet-beat path serves a cached snapshot without re-deriving _snapshot_reuse_key, whose input set is wider than the change token. _watch_snapshot (recovery_watch.py:1292-1302) drops a stored snapshot on any change to _snapshot_reuse_key, which composes _classification_inputs (reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py:390-420): the pointer, the manifest, the pointer's own log, the run directory's exit/worker/attempt records, the review store's candidates for the run, and the run's worktree git head. _crew_home_change_token stamps only the pointer, the newest stream, the manifest and the live//runs/ directory mtimes, so a change confined to a run-dir record, a review-store candidate or the worktree head with no pointer/stream/manifest movement leaves the stored snapshot in place and the transition unreported. The window is bounded by the next movement of a stamped file — short in an active fleet, watchless on a fleet whose only run is idle.

Landed, recovery_watch.py:2530 computes a stat-only token each poll and the listing, handover read and git sweeps run only under `if sweep:` at recovery_watch.py:2532, with _quiet_beat_snapshots re-taking the liveness probe on every beat; the gate also takes the lift fold (recovery_watch.py:2543) and the orphan sweep, which the goal did not name.
